baseline.question: What are some of the functions of the moed app?

answer.message: MOED helps with event planning, communication, and task management. It connects people, events, and next actions in one place. Key functions include managing inquiries, creating engagements, tracking tasks, and maintaining communication history. The app also supports calendar integration and profile management.

Then, ensure the event is marked as Confirmed. Finally, use the Map and Calendar feature to add it to your personal calendar.

code_findings.title: Event edits can launch new-event creation
code_findings.finding: The keyword fast path matches additions, negations, and start-date edits as new-event creation before semantic interpretation.
code_findings.reproduction: How do I add a second day to an existing event?
code_findings.fix: Restrict the fast path to explicit creation of the event itself; route edits and negations by resolved intent, with negative regression cases.

code_findings.title: Submitting a question discards the visible walkthrough step
code_findings.finding: endWorkflow clears currentStep before the request is assembled; Explain this step reaches the server without its context.
code_findings.reproduction: At Waiting on, ask Explain this step. Synthetic DOM test posts step:"".
code_findings.fix: Snapshot the last visible step and workflow before ending the interactive guide; send that snapshot as context without keeping the guide active.

code_findings.title: Back/Forward restoration can leave an answer waiting
code_findings.finding: pagehide cancels polling; no pageshow recovery resumes it when a cached page returns. Composer remains read-only.
code_findings.reproduction: Restore an in-progress polling page from the Back/Forward cache. Synthetic lifecycle test has zero timers after restoration.
code_findings.fix: On pageshow, reconcile saved conversation state and resume pending status recovery without duplicate replies.

code_findings.title: Pronoun follow-ups cannot select their walkthrough
code_findings.finding: Candidate workflow enums depend only on the latest question, preventing the model from using conversation history to resolve adding one.
code_findings.reproduction: After discussing speaker-notes PDFs, ask Can you walk me through adding one? Allowed workflow enum is only none.
code_findings.fix: Resolve subject and action from bounded conversation context, then validate the proposed workflow and prerequisites.

code_findings.title: Coach HTTP tests skip in the standard CI environment
code_findings.finding: Only explicit coach mode enables the feature flag; the standard disposable CI run leaves it off, so HTTP tests exit successfully without executing.
code_findings.reproduction: .github/workflows/ci.yml:253 runs the default disposable suite; tests/ai_coach_http_integration_test.php:3 requires an enabled coach.
code_findings.fix: Run the coach-specific disposable integration mode in required CI, or include an enabled coach environment in the standard isolated suite.
